description: This PHP file defines a trait 'RunAction' that provides reusable methods for executing actions with status reporting, including handling verbose output and exception management, within the context of the Daux console application.

methods.name: getLength
methods.description: Determines the length of the given content, using mb_strlen if available for multibyte character support; otherwise, uses strlen.

methods.name: runAction
methods.description: Executes a closure with a formatted status output, handling verbosity and exceptions, and indicating success or failure.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Outputs a status message with appropriate padding, respecting verbosity settings.
